description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service API. It extends from AwsClient and specifies methods for retrieving entitlements synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MarketplaceEntitlementServiceClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service, providing methods to call the service's actions.

methods.name: getEntitlements
methods.description: Synchronous method to retrieve entitlements from the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service.

methods.name: getEntitlementsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve entitlements, returning a promise.
